faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Calistoga?
faq.answer: Calistoga homeowners typically invest $6,000 to $14,000 for a full window replacement project. Wine country properties and historic downtown Victorian homes may require custom sizing to match original period profiles. Estate homes on the hillsides above Calistoga can see projects in the $20,000+ range depending on window count and glass specification.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Calistoga?
faq.answer: Yes. Calistoga requires a building permit for window replacement. Properties in or adjacent to the historic downtown corridor may need review by the City's Design Review Committee to ensure replacements are consistent with the architectural character of the area. Our team manages all permit applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Calistoga?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Calistoga commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Calistoga?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Calistoga replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Calistoga?
faq.answer: Most Calistoga projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
